title: Authority map
summary: Survey semantics, reusable mathematics, physical simulation and foreign runtime/provider execution remain separate authorities.
invariants: Maths owns vector/matrix/transform/ray/plane/numerical-solver semantics and precision/provider policy.
Physics World owns physical meaning and is a dependency direction below Photo World; Physics must not import survey classes.
Macrospace and Alchemy Foreign Object own Python class/object projection and lifetime, not survey geometry.
Depth Anything, GeoCLIP, PyMeshLab and OpenCV-derived output are evidence candidates, not world authority.

provenance.claim: Photo World authority and sealed-delivery boundary.
